display_long_description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE PLAYING
**We are excited to announce that the Grimlord Early Access is now live on Quest Applab!**
Join us in the full adventure by purchasing the Early Access on Applab. Your support isn't just a purchase; it's a key to unlocking the future of the Grimlord universe. 
Store Link: https://www.meta.com/experiences/6784503354964529

**The Grimlord Free Demo is also updated to demonstrate improvements we have made since June.**
The free demo will end on March 31st, so enjoy it while we can!
The demo is a glimpse of the full adventure and a demonstration of improvements. We wish to offer a chance for you to try the game and then decide whether it's your dish. Give it a go and see what you think!

ABOUT
From the lowest of beginnings, fight your way out. Your fighting style is unrestricted, your crafting options are limitless, and your enemies are versatile and fierce. Your future and the future of this land lie in your hands.
This is a story-driven, classic action RPG that is native to VR interactions. This is what’s been missing for long. This is Grimlord.

KEY FEATURES
* Creative Combat Styles - Hold your weapon wherever you want, however, you want, and use real-life fight styles to defeat your foe.
* Immerse into a good-ole Souls-style map loop, where every short-cut and fire point gives a sense of safety 
* Weaponry Customization - Dozens of weapon parts to unlock and hundreds of combinations
* Variety of Enemies & Epic Boss Fight
